name: continuous_update_coord
doc: **Varying one coordinate of a point is continuous.** The inner step of the path.
stmt:
theorem continuous_update_coord (p : Pt n) (i : Fin n) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Function.update p i (p i + t))
proof:
by
  have h1 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => p i + t) := continuous_const.add continuous_id
  exact Continuous.update continuous_const i h1

name: continuous_update_slot
doc: **Varying one slot of a point sequence is continuous.** The outer step of the path.
stmt:
theorem continuous_update_slot (pts : ℕ → Pt n) (a : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun v : Pt n => Function.update pts a v)
proof: Continuous.update continuous_const a continuous_id

name: continuous_samePoint_path
doc: **The `.samePoint` path is continuous.**
stmt:
theorem continuous_samePoint_path (pts : ℕ → Pt n) (a : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      Function.update pts a (Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + t)))
proof:
by
  have h1 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + t)) :=
    continuous_update_coord (pts a) i
  exact Continuous.update continuous_const a h1

name: samePoint_path_zero
doc: **The path starts at `pts`.**
stmt:
theorem samePoint_path_zero (pts : ℕ → Pt n) (a : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    Function.update pts a (Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + 0)) = pts
proof:
by
  simp

name: samePoint_path_of_ne
doc: **The path leaves every other slot alone.**
stmt:
theorem samePoint_path_of_ne (pts : ℕ → Pt n) (a : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ a) :
    Function.update pts a (Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + t)) j = pts j
proof: Function.update_noteq hj _ pts

name: sq_lt_sq_iff_mul_sign
doc: **Squaring loses a comparison exactly when the sign condition holds.**
stmt:
theorem sq_lt_sq_iff_mul_sign (d t : ℝ) :
    (d + t) ^ 2 < d ^ 2 ↔ t * (2 * d + t) < 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h; nlinarith
  · intro h; nlinarith

name: sqDist_along_path_split
doc: **The penalty along the path, with the moving coordinate split off.**
stmt:
theorem sqDist_along_path_split (p q : Pt n) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    sqDist (n := n) (Function.update p i (p i + t)) q
      = (p i + t - q i) ^ 2 + ∑ j in Finset.univ \ {i}, (p j - q j) ^ 2
proof:
by
  rw [sqDist_eq_coord_add_rest]
  congr 1
  · rw [Function.update_same]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
    have hji : j ≠ i := by
      intro h
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).2 (by simp [h])
    rw [Function.update_noteq hji]

name: sqDist_along_path_lt
doc:
**Along the path the penalty strictly decreases**, provided the sign condition on `t` holds.

The hypothesis keeps two questions apart: whether a decreasing `t` exists is arithmetic
(`sq_lt_sq_iff_mul_sign`), whether it is small enough to stay inside a neighbourhood is topology.
proof:
by
  rw [sqDist_along_path_split, sqDist_eq_coord_add_rest]
  have hsq := (sq_lt_sq_iff_mul_sign (p i - q i) t).mpr h
  linarith

name: neg_mul_two_add_neg_mul_neg
doc:
**The sign condition holds for a scaled `-d`.** With `0 < m <= 1`, the point `-d * m` lies in the interval where
the product is negative.
stmt:
theorem neg_mul_two_add_neg_mul_neg (d m : ℝ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm1 : m ≤ 1) :
    -d * m * (2 * d + -d * m) < 0
proof:
by
  have hd2 : 0 < d ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hpos : 0 < m * (2 - m) := by nlinarith
  have hEq : -d * m * (2 * d + -d * m) = -(d ^ 2) * m * (2 - m) := by ring
  rw [hEq]
  nlinarith

name: exists_small_descent
doc:
**A decreasing step can be made arbitrarily small.**

For every `ε > 0` there is a `t` with `0 < |t| < ε` satisfying the sign condition of `sqDist_along_path_lt`. This is
the arithmetic half of "the path leaves the point in a decreasing direction *and* stays nearby"; the topology is in
`continuous_samePoint_path`.
stmt:
theorem exists_small_descent (d : ℝ) (hd : d ≠ 0) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 ∧ |t| < ε ∧ t * (2 * d + t) < 0
proof:
by
  have hDpos : 0 < |d| := abs_pos.mpr hd
  set m : ℝ := min 1 (ε / (2 * |d|)) with hm
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    rw [hm]
    exact lt_min one_pos (by positivity)
  have hm1 : m ≤ 1 := by rw [hm]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hmle : m ≤ ε / (2 * |d|) := by rw [hm]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := le_of_lt hmpos
  refine ⟨-d * m, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·                        
    intro hzero
    have hdm : d * m = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hdm with h | h
    · exact hd h
    · exact (ne_of_gt hmpos) h
  ·                     
    have hDm : |d| * m ≤ ε / 2 := by
      calc |d| * m ≤ |d| * (ε / (2 * |d|)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmle (le_of_lt hDpos)
        _ = ε / 2 := by field_simp; ring
    have habs : |-d * m| = |d| * m := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hmpos]
    rw [habs]
    linarith
  ·                            
    have := neg_mul_two_add_neg_mul_neg d m hd hmpos hm1
    linarith [this]

name: not_eventually_zero_of_small_counterexample
doc:
**An `Eventually` property at `0` is incompatible with counterexamples at every scale.**

The general form of the last step. Note the hypothesis is exactly what `exists_small_descent` provides: for every
`ε > 0`, a `t` with `|t| < ε` where the property fails.
stmt:
theorem not_eventually_zero_of_small_counterexample {P : ℝ → Prop}
    (h : ∀ᶠ t in nhds (0 : ℝ), P t)
    (hbad : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t : ℝ, |t| < ε ∧ ¬ P t) :
    False
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdprop⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hnot⟩ := hbad d hd
  exact hnot (hdprop (by simpa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using ht))

name: sqDist_samePoint_not_localMin
doc:
**A configuration with `pts a ≠ pts b` is not a local minimum of the `.samePoint` penalty's square.**

The five earlier pieces feed this: local minimality pulls back along `continuous_samePoint_path` to an `Eventually`
statement at `0`, `exists_small_descent` supplies a witness at every scale, and
`not_eventually_zero_of_small_counterexample` turns the pair into a contradiction.

Nothing here is specific to `EqConstraint.poly (.samePoint a b)` beyond reading its penalty as `sqDist (pts a) (pts b)`.
stmt:
theorem sqDist_samePoint_not_localMin (a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ b) (pts : ℕ → Pt n)
    (hne : pts a ≠ pts b) :
    ¬ IsLocalMin (fun x : ℕ → Pt n => (sqDist (n := n) (x a) (x b)) ^ 2) pts
proof:
by
  intro hmin
                            
  have hex : ∃ i : Fin n, pts a i ≠ pts b i := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    exact hne (funext hall)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
  have hd : pts a i - pts b i ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hi
                                                  
  have hcont : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ => Function.update pts a (Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + t)))
      (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds pts) := by
    have hc := (continuous_samePoint_path pts a i).tendsto 0
    simpa using hc
                                              
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t in nhds (0 : ℝ),
      (sqDist (n := n) (pts a) (pts b)) ^ 2
        ≤ (sqDist (n := n)
            ((fun s : ℝ => Function.update pts a (Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + s))) t a)
            ((fun s : ℝ => Function.update pts a (Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + s))) t b)) ^ 2 :=
    hcont.eventually hmin
                                      
  refine not_eventually_zero_of_small_counterexample hev (fun ε hε => ?_)
  obtain ⟨t, _ht0, htε, htlt⟩ := exists_small_descent (pts a i - pts b i) hd hε
  refine ⟨t, htε, ?_⟩
                                                           
  set A : ℝ := sqDist (n := n) (Function.update (pts a) i (pts a i + t)) (pts b) with hA
  set B : ℝ := sqDist (n := n) (pts a) (pts b) with hB
  have hnnA : (0 : ℝ) ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact sqDist_nonneg _ _
  have hlt : A < B := by
    rw [hA, hB]
    exact sqDist_along_path_lt (pts a) (pts b) i htlt

name: sqDist_eq_resid
doc:
**`sqDist` on the flattened carrier is `Differentiable`'s residual.**

The two files reach the same function by different routes: `Dist` defines `sqDist` as a sum over coordinates of
squared differences of `Pt` components, and `Differentiable` builds `∑ i, segComp a b i v ^ 2` from projections.
This lemma is where they are identified, and it is what lets the smoothness result transfer.
stmt:
theorem sqDist_eq_resid {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k) (v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ) :
    sqDist (n := n) (unflatten v a) (unflatten v b)
      = ∑ i, segComp a b i v ^ 2
proof:
by
  unfold sqDist segComp Lattice.Lib.Linear.PenaltyVector.sqNorm diff
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  ring

name: differentiable_sqDist
doc: **The squared distance between two points is differentiable on the flattened carrier.**
stmt:
theorem differentiable_sqDist {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ =>
      sqDist (n := n) (unflatten v a) (unflatten v b))
proof:
by
  simpa only [sqDist_eq_resid] using differentiable_sqDistResid (n := n) a b

name: differentiable_sqDistEqPenalty
doc:
**`sqDistEq`'s penalty is differentiable**, whenever the expression on the right side is.

The hypothesis `hd` is the expression's smoothness, which `Lattice.Geo.ExprDeriv.hasFDerivAt_eval` supplies for any
`GeoExpr` on a large enough carrier. Stating it as a hypothesis keeps this file independent of the carrier bound.
stmt:
theorem differentiable_sqDistEqPenalty {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k) (d : GeoExpr n)
    (hd : Differentiable ℝ (fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ => d.evalPts (toNatConfig v))) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ => sqDistEqPenalty a b d (toNatConfig v))
proof:
by
                                                                                   
  have h : (fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ => sqDistEqPenalty a b d (toNatConfig v))
      = fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ =>
          (sqDist (n := n) (unflatten v a) (unflatten v b) - d.evalPts (toNatConfig v)) ^ 2 := by
    funext v
    unfold sqDistEqPenalty twoValuedPenalty
                                                                   
    have hc : ∀ i : Fin k, toNatConfig v i = unflatten v i := by
      intro i
      unfold toNatConfig
      rw [dif_pos i.isLt]
    simp only [hc]
  rw [h]
  exact ((differentiable_sqDist a b).sub hd).pow 2

name: differentiable_equalLengthPenalty
doc: **`equalLength`'s penalty is differentiable**: a difference of two squared distances, squared.
stmt:
theorem differentiable_equalLengthPenalty {k : ℕ} (a b c e : Fin k) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ => equalLengthPenalty a b c e (toNatConfig v))
proof:
by
  have h : (fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ => equalLengthPenalty a b c e (toNatConfig v))
      = fun v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ =>
          (sqDist (n := n) (unflatten v a) (unflatten v b)
            - sqDist (n := n) (unflatten v c) (unflatten v e)) ^ 2 := by
    funext v
    unfold equalLengthPenalty twoValuedPenalty
    have hc : ∀ i : Fin k, toNatConfig v i = unflatten v i := by
      intro i
      unfold toNatConfig
      rw [dif_pos i.isLt]
    simp only [hc]
  rw [h]
  exact ((differentiable_sqDist a b).sub (differentiable_sqDist c e)).pow 2

end Lattice.Geo

name: bump
doc:
**The unit bump at one entry of the flattened vector.**

`bump b i` is `1` at the slot the layout assigns to coordinate `i` of point `b`, and `0` elsewhere. It is
the dual of `Lattice.Geo.Differentiable.coordProj`, and like `coordProj` it is *named* rather than written
inline: an `if` inside a `•` inside a `HasFDerivAt` goal brings the elaborator no further.
stmt: noncomputable def bump (k n : ℕ) (b : Fin k) (i : Fin n) : Fin (k * n) → ℝ
proof: fun j => if j = flatEquiv k n (b, i) then 1 else 0

name: bump_self
stmt:
@[simp] theorem bump_self (b : Fin k) (i : Fin n) :
    bump k n b i (flatEquiv k n (b, i)) = 1
proof:
by
  simp [bump]

name: bump_ne
stmt:
theorem bump_ne {b : Fin k} {i : Fin n} {j : Fin (k * n)}
    (h : j ≠ flatEquiv k n (b, i)) : bump k n b i j = 0
proof:
by
  simp [bump, h]

name: unflatten_add
doc: **`unflatten` is additive**: it reads one entry, and reading is additive.
stmt:
theorem unflatten_add (v w : Fin (k * n) → ℝ) (p : Fin k) (q : Fin n) :
    unflatten (v + w) p q = unflatten v p q + unflatten w p q
proof:
by
  simp [unflatten]

name: unflatten_smul_bump_same
doc:
**Reading the bumped entry gives the scale.** Here `flatEquiv`'s injectivity is used: equal images
force the pairs to be equal.
stmt:
theorem unflatten_smul_bump_same (b : Fin k) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    unflatten (t • bump k n b i) b i = t
proof:
by
  simp [unflatten, bump]

name: unflatten_smul_bump_ne
doc: **Reading any other entry of a bumped vector gives zero.**
stmt:
theorem unflatten_smul_bump_ne {b p : Fin k} {i q : Fin n} (hpq : ¬(p = b ∧ q = i)) (t : ℝ) :
    unflatten (t • bump k n b i) p q = 0
proof:
by
  simp only [unflatten, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hne : flatEquiv k n (p, q) ≠ flatEquiv k n (b, i) := by
    intro h
    exact hpq (Prod.ext_iff.mp (Equiv.injective _ h))
  rw [bump_ne hne, mul_zero]

name: unflatten_add_smul_bump
doc: **How `unflatten` responds to a bump**, in the single form the geometry cites.
stmt:
theorem unflatten_add_smul_bump (b : Fin k) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) (v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ)
    (p : Fin k) (q : Fin n) :
    unflatten (v + t • bump k n b i) p q
      = unflatten v p q + (if p = b ∧ q = i then t else 0)
proof:
by
  by_cases h : p = b ∧ q = i
  · rw [if_pos h]
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [unflatten_add, unflatten_smul_bump_same]
  · rw [if_neg h, unflatten_add, unflatten_smul_bump_ne h, add_zero]

name: seg
doc: The `i`-th component of the displacement from `a` to `b`.
stmt: noncomputable def seg (a b : Fin k) (i : Fin n) (v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: unflatten v b i - unflatten v a i

name: seg_bump_far
doc:
**Bumping `b`'s `i`-th coordinate raises the `i`-th component of `seg a b` by `t`**, provided the
bumped point is that segment's far endpoint.
stmt:
theorem seg_bump_far (a b : Fin k) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) (v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ) (hba : b ≠ a) :
    seg a b i (v + t • bump k n b i) = seg a b i v + t
proof:
by
  unfold seg
  rw [unflatten_add_smul_bump, unflatten_add_smul_bump, if_pos (And.intro rfl rfl)]
  have hb : ¬(a = b ∧ i = i) := by
    intro h; exact hba h.1.symm
  rw [if_neg hb]
  ring

name: seg_bump_far_ne
doc: **Bumping `b`'s `i`-th coordinate leaves the other components of `seg a b` alone.**
stmt:
theorem seg_bump_far_ne (a b : Fin k) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) (v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ)
    (hba : b ≠ a) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    seg a b j (v + t • bump k n b i) = seg a b j v
proof:
by
  unfold seg
  rw [unflatten_add_smul_bump, unflatten_add_smul_bump]
  have hb : ¬(b = b ∧ j = i) := by
    intro h; exact hji h.2
  have ha : ¬(a = b ∧ j = i) := by
    intro h; exact hba h.1.symm
  rw [if_neg hb, if_neg ha, add_zero, add_zero]

name: seg_bump_other
doc: **Bumping `b` leaves a segment that does not touch `b` unchanged.**
stmt:
theorem seg_bump_other (c e b : Fin k) (i j : Fin n) (t : ℝ) (v : Fin (k * n) → ℝ)
    (hbc : b ≠ c) (hbe : b ≠ e) :
    seg c e j (v + t • bump k n b i) = seg c e j v
proof:
by
  unfold seg
  rw [unflatten_add_smul_bump, unflatten_add_smul_bump]
  have he : ¬(e = b ∧ j = i) := by
    intro h; exact hbe h.1.symm
  have hc : ¬(c = b ∧ j = i) := by
    intro h; exact hbc h.1.symm
  rw [if_neg he, if_neg hc, add_zero, add_zero]

end Lattice.Geo
